name: Zero Trust Access Policy
description: Structure documenting the Zero Trust access policy evaluated by a Policy Decision Point (PDP) per NIST SP 800-207.

properties.name: policyId
properties.description: Unique identifier for this access policy.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of the policy's purpose and scope.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Policy version in semantic versioning format.

properties.name: effect
properties.description: Whether the policy allows or denies access. Enum: allow, deny.

properties.name: subjects
properties.description: Principals (users, service accounts, workloads) this policy applies to.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Type of principal: user, group, service-account, workload, device.

properties.name: resources
properties.description: Resources this policy governs access to.

properties.name: conditions
properties.description: Contextual conditions that must be satisfied for the policy to apply.

properties.name: allowedIpRanges
properties.description: CIDR ranges from which access is permitted.

properties.name: requireVpn
properties.description: Whether VPN or ZTNA tunnel is required.

properties.name: enforcementMode
properties.description: Whether the policy is actively enforced or audit-only. Enum: enforce, audit, disabled.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Date the policy was created (ISO 8601 date).

properties.name: modified
properties.description: Date the policy was last modified (ISO 8601 date).

properties.name: owner
properties.description: Team or individual responsible for this policy.
